meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Nostr WoT handles your data on the website, in the browser extension, in the Nostr WoT iOS / Android app and its hosted Lightning wallet, and in the Oracle API.

intro.description: This Privacy Policy describes how Nostr Web of Trust ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our website (nostrwot.com), our browser extension (WoT Extension) and the Nostr WoT app for iOS / Android.
intro.commitment: We are committed to protecting your privacy. As a project built for the Nostr ecosystem, we understand the importance of decentralization and user sovereignty over personal data.

extension.title: Browser Extension Privacy
extension.intro: The WoT Extension is designed with privacy as a core principle. Here's what you need to know:

pubkey.title: Your Pubkey:
pubkey.description: Stored locally in your browser to identify your position in the social graph. Never sent to our servers.

configuration.title: Configuration:
configuration.description: Your settings (operating mode, relay preferences, oracle URL) are stored locally in your browser.

localGraph.title: Local Graph Index:
localGraph.description: In Local or Hybrid mode, follow relationships are stored in your browser's IndexedDB. This data never leaves your device.

operatingModes.title: Operating Modes
operatingModes.description: The extension offers three operating modes with different privacy implications:

items.processedLocally: All queries are processed locally in your browser
items.fetchedDirectly: Follow data is fetched directly from Nostr relays
items.noDataSent: No data is sent to the WoT Oracle or our servers

items.sentToOracle: Queries are sent to the WoT Oracle API to calculate social distance
items.oracleSees: The Oracle sees which pubkeys you are querying (but not your identity unless you reveal it)
items.fasterResults: Provides faster results with less local storage
items.selfHost: Consider using a self-hosted Oracle for enhanced privacy

items.fallback: Falls back to Remote mode only when needed

doesNot.title: What the Extension Does NOT Do

items.browsingHistory: We do not collect or transmit your browsing history
items.ads: We do not inject ads or tracking scripts
items.sellData: We do not sell or share your data with third parties
items.privateKeys: We do not store your private keys (we never have access to them)
items.telemetry: We do not run analytics or telemetry in the extension

app.title: Nostr WoT app (iOS and Android)
app.intro: Nostr WoT signs Nostr requests for compatible apps. Connect your own node through LNbits or a wallet through Nostr Wallet Connect (NWC). The optional hosted wallet is a separate custodial service operated by DANDELION LABS JOINT STOCK COMPANY at zaps.nostr-wot.com: the company holds its funds.

keys.title: Keys, unlocking and recovery
keys.description: Private keys, wallet connection secrets, permissions, settings and activity are stored on your phone; keys are protected in an encrypted vault. Onboarding offers an automatic lock timer and a six-digit device PIN, with optional biometrics handled by the operating system. Choosing never to lock skips the PIN. We cannot reset your PIN or recover a lost seed phrase.

recovery.title: Creating or recovering an identity
recovery.description: Passkey recovery encrypts your seed phrase. New backups do not include account names, account lists or derivation paths; older backups may include them. Your credential provider can store the encrypted recovery copy. If you consent to relay storage, it can instead be published to Nostr relays. Recovery uses the provider and, when needed, configured recovery relays (currently nos.lol, relay.damus.io and nostr-01.yakihonne.com). Passkey availability and synchronization depend on your provider. Keep an independent recovery copy.

network.title: Network connections and recipients
network.description: Remote signing (NIP-46), profiles, relay lists, published events, Archive synchronization and NWC use Nostr relays. Encrypted requests hide their content from relays, but relays can see public keys, IP addresses and connection times. Published events and profile information can be public. Paired devices can also exchange encrypted requests over the local network or Bluetooth where supported. Android supports NIP-55; compatible iPhone apps can use the signing action extension.

providers.title: Third-Party Services
providers.description: LNbits receives requests at the server you configure; NWC sends encrypted requests through its configured relay to your wallet provider. Those operators process payment data under their own policies. Lightning address services receive invoice lookups. Image hosts receive image requests; Google’s favicon service receives connected-site domains and your IP address. Public GitHub support reports contain whatever you submit, including any prefilled app, OS and device details. The current mobile apps have no built-in Tor, embedded Breez/Spark wallet or post-quantum signing. The app has no advertising or analytics tracking; these service connections still process data. NIP-05 verification contacts the identifier’s domain. Fiat conversion rates are requested from Coinbase. LNURL and compatible NFC card operations contact the service encoded in the address or card. These services receive your IP address and request data. Privacy mode limits activity recording and third-party profile content; it does not make all network use anonymous.

hostedWallet.title: Optional hosted wallet and retention
hostedWallet.description: DANDELION LABS JOINT STOCK COMPANY holds the hosted wallet funds. The service stores your Nostr public key, wallet identifiers, balance, invoices, payment amounts, dates and status, claimed public Lightning address and NWC app connections with their limits. It processes network request data and operational logs to provide and secure the service. Wallet records remain while the wallet exists; we do not promise a fixed deletion period for operational logs or backups. The hosted service can move its funds, and access depends on its availability. Connecting another wallet does not by itself make that wallet self-custodial: custody depends on its operator.

delete.title: Deleting data and getting help
delete.description: Remove an account in Accounts or use Delete all data in Settings to erase local app data. Move hosted funds out first and select the separate hosted-wallet deletion option; local erasure alone does not delete the server wallet. The deletion flow reports server failures. A completed hosted deletion removes the wallet, payment history, Lightning address, app connections and account association. If you no longer have the app, use our contact form to request deletion. Never send a seed phrase, private key, PIN or wallet connection secret.

copies.title: Data Retention
copies.description: Local deletion does not remove passkeys, recovery copies held by credential providers, exported files or published relay data. Manage passkeys with your credential provider and delete exported copies where you saved them. Relays and recipients may retain copies even after a deletion request. We cannot guarantee erasure of those copies or recover your keys if all recovery methods are lost.
